title: ZA-2024-6488-CU2-1A
text:
ZA-2024-6488-CU2-1A  Council District: 5 – Yaroslavsky
  CEQA: ENV-2024-6489-CE  Last Day to Act: 08-25-26
  Plan Area: Wilshire  Continued from: 06-23-26

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  200 and 202 South Orange Drive; 5566 West 2nd Street

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Legalize the conversion of an existing main building (duplex) and the first level of an existing detached
  accessory building (garage) into a house of worship (synagogue) use. The first floor of the main building is
  used for assembly; the second level is a residence for caretakers of the property. The first level of the
  accessory building is for caretaking of children under the age of eight years while their parents attend
  religious services; the second level of the accessory building is a residence and not a part of the applicant’s
  request.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the April 9, 2026 Zoning Administrator’s Determination which:
  1. Determined, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the Project is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 1
  (existing facilities) and Section 15303, Class 3 (new construction or conversion of small structures),
  and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that any exception to a categorical exemption
  pursuant to CEQA guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies;
  2. Approved, pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 12.24 W.9 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code, a Class 2
  conditional use permit to allow the use and maintenance of a house of worship (synagogue) in an
  existing main building and existing detached accessory building in the R2-1 Zone; and
  3. Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  Applicant:  Yekusiel Kalmenson
  Representative: Jacob Israel, Beth Palmer
